messages:
nisha: Trying the CLI quickstart from README; `redwood quickstart run` starts the sample app but first API call fails with 403. logs show workspace mismatch? anyone seen this when using the Docker sample?

rc: what does the error look like in the container logs? and which REDWOOD_API_KEY did you pass to the container?

nisha: log excerpt from container:
```
2025-05-10T14:02:13Z ERROR request failed status=403 body={\"detail\":\"key not valid for workspace: demo-team != my-team\"}
```
I launched with `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$KEY -p 8080:8080 redwood/quickstart:latest`

billing-bot: Note: Org 'demo-team' has no billing profile. Hosted API calls will be denied until a billing profile is attached.

nisha: i think the sample app default workspace is demo-team but my personal key is scoped to my-team. so container is hitting demo-team and getting 403. the message was a bit confusing and read like a billing failure at first glance.

rc: good catch. two separate issues: (1) sample's default config expects org 'demo-team' which can confuse users who use org-scoped keys, (2) error message mixes workspace mismatch and billing gating in a way that hides the real root cause.

harper: workaround: set REDWOOD_ORG=my-team when running the container or use a service key scoped to demo-team. e.g.:
```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$KEY -e REDWOOD_ORG=my-team -p 8080:8080 redwood/quickstart:latest
```
that made the quickstart first call succeed for me.

nisha: adding REDWOOD_ORG fixed it locally, and the first call returns 200 now. thanks.

rc: i'll file two follow-ups: (1) change the quickstart Docker image to read org from env and fall back to the key's default org instead of hardcoding demo-team, (2) improve the error text to state "workspace mismatch: key belongs to X, request targeted Y; ensure REDWOOD_ORG or key scope match; billing only blocks requests when org has no billing".

console-team: captured. We'll also add a small onboarding banner in the console and CLI that warns about "org/key mismatch" in the first-run flow.

nisha: tiny DX note: the README implies "create org" -> "try quickstart" but doesn't call out the org env var. adding one line would have saved me 10 minutes.

rc: agreed. thanks for the report — creating tickets RDW-5120 (quickstart image), RDW-5121 (docs), RDW-5122 (error text). closing when PRs merged.
